applies_to: every role; the effective S at the attempt is max(frozen S, p-values actually reported) per role (stricter only, R8)
note: PractRand with -a prints a fixed set of results per checkpoint; the positive-control 2^35 run (5366 p-values) is shorter, so its 1 TiB count is taken to equal the candidate's. Any larger actual count raises S automatically.

projection.method: slot scheduler simulation (32 slots; PractRand 6, TestU01 2; longest first) with the rehearsal run times of phyco-v2
projection.note: negative control stops PractRand early, positive control stream is faster; equivalence check adds minutes. Below the 5-day limit, no owner decision needed.

disclaimer: Passing NIST SP 800-22 does not show cryptographic security. This generator must not be used to generate secrets; use an established cryptographic random-number generator for keys, nonces, tokens and salts.
